WITH web_v1 AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, 
           SUM(ws_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY ws_item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    ) AS filtered_date
    ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
    WHERE web_sales.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
store_v1 AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk AS item_sk, d_date, 
           SUM(ss_sales_price) OVER (PARTITION BY ss_item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
    ) AS filtered_date
    ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date.d_date_sk
    WHERE store_sales.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT item_sk, d_date, web_sales, store_sales,
       SUM(web_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS web_cumulative,
       SUM(store_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY item_sk ORDER BY d_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS store_cumulative
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(web_v1.item_sk, store_v1.item_sk) AS item_sk,
           COALESCE(web_v1.d_date, store_v1.d_date) AS d_date,
           web_v1.cume_sales AS web_sales,
           store_v1.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM web_v1
    LEFT JOIN store_v1 ON web_v1.item_sk = store_v1.item_sk AND web_v1.d_date = store_v1.d_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT store_v1.item_sk, store_v1.d_date, web_v1.cume_sales AS web_sales, store_v1.cume_sales AS store_sales
    FROM store_v1
    LEFT JOIN web_v1 ON store_v1.item_sk = web_v1.item_sk AND store_v1.d_date = web_v1.d_date
) AS combined
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
